desktop.notes:
• Crop view: coming back to a photo (from the grid, or after pasting a crop) shows its stored crop - no stale or uncropped preview.
• Every album shows a thumbnail in the sidebar, even when none of its photos are in this folder (its cover, else its first photo, from any folder).
• Library auto-sync: every Keep and favourite goes to the Library a few seconds after you decide - not only album photos.
